versions.short: The bill would require the Secretary of Agriculture to transfer about 232.9 acres of national forest land in the Tonto National Forest in Arizona, known as the Pleasant Valley Ranger District Administrative Site, to Gila County, Arizona, if the county asks in writing within 180 days of the bill becoming law. The transfer would be made without payment, by quitclaim deed, and subject to existing rights, with the county paying all costs of the transfer, including any survey, environmental review, and historic preservation analysis. The federal government would not have to provide environmental covenants or warranties for the land. The county would have to use the land only to serve and support veterans of the Armed Forces, and if it did not, the land would return to the United States at the Secretary's discretion.
